title: Piggu's Festival Fair: A Money Adventure for Kids (Big Adventure 1)
content:
Piggu, Sikka, Granny Owl and Mr Hop go to the festival fair in our first Big Adventure! Watch, play the games and collect all 11 stars. ⭐

The story

Granny Owl gives Piggu 50 coins for the festival fair. "I can buy EVERYTHING!" says Piggu. But Sikka says, "Wait! Let's make a plan first. Coins can run out!"

At Mr Hop's stall, a big wheel ride costs 20 coins, popcorn 15, a balloon 10, a lollipop 5 and a teddy 40. Piggu picks a big wheel ride, popcorn, a balloon and a lollipop: 20 + 15 + 10 + 5 = 50 coins. Exactly 50!

Later Piggu sees a teddy for 40 coins at one stall and the same teddy for 30 coins at another. But Piggu has 0 coins left. Instead of staying grumpy, Piggu decides to save for the next fair. Granny is very proud!

Games in this episode

  • 🚪 Choose the door: plan first or rides first?
  • 🛍️ Mr Hop's Stall: pick things that add up to 50 coins or less (there is more than one right answer!)
  • 🎤 Piggu's Quiz Corner: 2 questions for little ones and 2 for big kids
  • 🤸 Move Break: jump when you see the golden coin
  • 🔍 Spot the difference: which teddy costs less?
  • 🧠 Can you remember? 3 memory questions

Today's lesson ⭐

Make a plan, then spend! 📝

Try it at home

Make your own fair at home! Draw 5 things on paper and give each a price. Give yourself 50 pretend coins and choose what to buy. Can you find two different plans that both add up to 50?

Next Big Adventure

Granny's Rainy Day Jar ☔ Come back to find out what happens!

For parents and teachers: MoneyViel Kids stories teach simple money ideas through play. We use "coins" instead of a real currency so children everywhere can follow along. This is for learning only.
